freezeNote: 2026-09-18 money-brief cluster: maxUrls raised 310 -> 370. Evidence and shape of the increase, per the routeStandards rule below. Ceiling (revised 2026-09-19 for batch 3): the sitemap stood at 306 after the S1 consolidation; the cluster adds 2 hub pages (/en/money/, /zh/money/) plus 104 briefs (52 topics x en/zh) for 412 at full release, leaving 13 URLs of headroom under maxUrls=425. Rate: releases are gated by a publishAt date in each brief's frontmatter (src/lib/publication.ts), one topic per day from 2026-09-18 to 2026-11-08, so the surface grows by 2 URLs/day -- about 0.65%/day against the 307 base, over 52 days. Compare the 2026-07 incident recorded in history below: 41 -> 341 URLs in 5 days, roughly 53%/day. The cap cannot be reached in a single merge even if every brief lands in one commit, because getStaticPaths emits only briefs whose date has arrived. Locale scope: en and zh only, because that is where measured demand is concentrated: per docs/audits/worthcalc-disposition-2026-09-15.csv, en and zh took 760 of the 873 impressions across the kept set (87%) in the recorded 3-month window. es/fr/de stay frozen for NEW routes per the i18n expansion policy in README.md and HUB_LOCALES in src/lib/topics.ts -- frozen, not worthless: they took the other 113 impressions, and de has the site's highest hit rate at 15 of 17 kept URLs. Demand evidence per topic is the dated primary-source figure each brief is built on (IRS 2026 mid-year mileage rate and 2026 inflation adjustments, EIA residential price, Freddie Mac PMMS, Federal Reserve G.19, FDIC national rates, SSA 2026 COLA, DOE AFDC home and public charging, DOL overtime guidance, IRS guidance on the PL 119-21 termination of sections 25C and 25D), recorded in each brief's sources block with its verification date.

capRemoved.decision: Lift the URL cap. The site is scaling SEO pages up deliberately, and every release had come to mean editing maxUrls first -- the guard had become paperwork rather than a decision.
capRemoved.whatRemains: check-url-budget.mjs no longer fails the build on a number. It still prints the URL count and the delta against the last recorded build every run, so the growth rate stays visible in the verify output instead of disappearing.

routeStandards: Every new route must be backed by written GA4/GSC evidence, reliable sources, a distinct human search intent, substantive copy, and sitemap reconciliation. Future writing batches are capped at 5 pages; related batches should accumulate into a coherent 30-60 page cluster before one deployment. Packages 047-052 add cleaning, boiling, brewing, drying, and steaming intents; packages 053-058 add cooking-cycle and prep-session intents for small kitchen appliances; packages 059-064 extend the cluster to pressure cooking, griddling, mixing, and espresso routines; packages 065-070 extend the same measured unit-cost method to baking, dehydration, incubation, reheating, and short motor-use routines; packages 071-076 extend it to ice making, juicing, grinding, extrusion, frothing, and hourly food holding; packages 077-082 extend the cluster to printing, scanning, 3D printing, gaming, soundbar viewing, and desktop-speaker listening units; packages 083-088 extend it to labeling, shredding, laminating, 3D scanning, standing-desk adjustment, and smart-speaker listening units, backed by EIA electricity-price and household-use context, ENERGY STAR computer/imaging-equipment guidance, and CFPB spending context. Packages 119-121 extend the measured unit-cost cluster to portable cooling, pool filtration, and dehumidifying hours. 2026-09-18: the money-brief cluster (/<locale>/money/) adds dated reference and break-even intents backed by IRS, EIA, Federal Reserve, FDIC and Freddie Mac primary sources. It is the first cluster on the site whose releases are rate-limited in code rather than by process: a publishAt date per page, enforced in getStaticPaths, so a batch merge cannot become a batch publication.

history.note: Kept as the record of a real incident. Do not delete: this is why the counter exists at all.
history.2026-07-25: Site-level ranking collapse. The sitemap went 41 -> 341 URLs between 2026-07-19 and 2026-07-23 (five-language site shell + a 100-page growth pack) on a YMYL money domain with no authority. GSC impressions fell from 87/day to 3/day and stayed there. Nothing in the pipeline noticed the URL count moving, which is why the cap was introduced.
history.2026-09-02: Cap lifted. It stood at 940 with the sitemap at 937, having been raised repeatedly through SEO clusters 023-064.
history.2026-09-18: Cap raised 310 -> 370 for the money-brief cluster. The raise is bounded by construction: 363 URLs at full release, 2 per day, and the rate is enforced by the publishAt gate rather than by remembering to stage commits.
history.2026-09-19: Correction. The 2026-09-18 note justified the en/zh scope by claiming es/fr/de had zero GSC impressions. That was wrong: the zero belongs to the deindexed 195 URLs, not the kept 141, which recorded 113 impressions across 50 URLs in the same window. The scope decision stands on demand concentration (87% of impressions in en/zh); the claim that the other locales are dead does not, and was removed here, in src/lib/moneyBriefs.ts and in docs/seo/MONEY-BRIEFS-CLUSTER.md. de in particular has the highest hit rate on the site.
history.2026-09-19-batch2: maxUrls 370 -> 395. Batch 2 adds 11 topics (22 pages) to the money-brief cluster, released 2026-10-15 to 2026-10-25 on the same one-topic-per-day gate. Full-release sitemap goes to 384. The rate is unchanged at 2 URLs/day; only the runway is longer (38 topics, 2026-09-18 to 2026-10-25).
history.2026-09-19-batch3: maxUrls 395 -> 425. Batch 3 adds 14 topics (28 pages), released 2026-10-26 to 2026-11-08 on the same one-topic-per-day gate: ira-vs-401k-priority-2026, hsa-vs-fsa-decision, gas-vs-ev-cost-per-mile-2026, internet-plan-cost-2026, umbrella-insurance-break-even, dental-insurance-vs-cash, home-improvement-roi-before-selling, car-repair-vs-trade-in, rent-increase-move-or-stay, overtime-vs-second-job, phone-upgrade-trade-in-timing, gym-membership-vs-pay-per-visit, savings-vs-cd-2026, inflation-adjusted-raise-2026. Full-release sitemap goes to 412 against maxUrls 425. The rate is unchanged at 2 URLs/day; only the runway is longer (52 topics, 2026-09-18 to 2026-11-08). Every source URL in the batch is one already proven elsewhere in this repository, because egress in the authoring environment is restricted to search and external URLs cannot be fetched to verify them.
